prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Works: It Just Predicts the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT generate answers by predicting one word at a time. This short video explains how training on huge amounts of text makes that simple trick so powerful.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't think up answers. It guesses one word at a time. That's the whole trick, and it's why it can write almost anything.

props.text: It just predicts the next word.

beats.narration: First, it reads a huge amount of text from books and websites. Over and over, it practices guessing the missing word, until the guesses get good.
Then you type a question. The model picks a likely next word, adds it, and repeats. Word by word, a full answer appears.
So it's a powerful pattern machine, not a mind. It can sound sure and still be wrong, so check what matters.

props.text: Sounds sure doesn't mean it's right.
